scope.compilerTools: General-purpose unmodified compilers, bootstrap SDK and Xcode are not copied as product runtime. Exact LLVM runtime source subtrees (libcxx, libcxxabi, libunwind, compiler-rt) and their CMake/header/script inputs are supplied at each compiler DEPS revision, including the CLI prebuilt static libc++. Engine separately supplies its DEPS libcxx/libcxxabi source-built libraries.
scope.configuration: Native release target graph. Remote build execution, unrelated tests/examples disabled; upstream CI recipes preserved. Source closure is not an exact original-build flag or bit reproducibility claim.
